rules.tradeModel: signal known after the close; entry at the NEXT day open plus slippage (0.1% to 0.6% per side by liquidity); exit at +8.000000000000007% target, -5.000000000000004% stop (gap through the stop fills at the open), or close of day 10; same-day touch of both counts as stop; 0.4% round-trip fees/FX assumed; 25% Israeli capital-gains tax shown separately (no loss offset)
rules.text: close > highest high of prior 20 days; today volume >= 1.5x and 5-day avg volume >= 1.2x of prior 20-day avg; price >= $3; 20d avg dollar volume >= $5M; market cap $300M-$10B; excludes >25% one-day or >60% 5-day jumps; ETFs, test, OTC, warrants, units, preferred excluded. "Strong" adds: volume >= 2x, above 50-day average, no trap flags, S&P 500 (SPY) above its 50-day average. An alert needs: strong signal, verified market cap, market regime ok, AND the strong signal type has positive net expectancy in both halves of the last ~2 years with enough samples and bounded drawdown.

backtestPortfolio.label: RETROSPECTIVE backtest portfolio (what would have happened on past data; not forward results)
backtestPortfolio.fxNote: open.er-api.com, today rate applied to the whole period

notModeled: delisted/failed stocks (free data lists only current symbols)
halts and gaps beyond the open
real bid/ask spread and partial fills
intraday path (same-day target and stop touch is counted as a stop)
tax loss offsets and currency conversion (ILS/USD)

historicalStats.note: Measured on the last ~2 years of symbols listed TODAY (survivorship bias: delisted losers are missing, so real results are likely worse). The same data was used to shape the rules (in-sample). Signals cluster on the same market days, so they are not independent. Real slippage on small names can exceed these assumptions; halts, bid/ask spreads and partial fills are not modeled; the free data is end-of-day and delayed; no intraday data. Past results are not a guarantee.

disclaimer: Filters reduce but cannot eliminate pump, manipulation or trap risk. Catalyst/news and float are not checked here. Signals, not investment advice.
